name: Deal Match
office_task: Every morning, check each CRM deal against its Simpro quote by quote id, show each difference in value, stage, customer or contact with both values, and change one only once a person accepts it.
systems_of_record: the CRM (holds each sales deal, carries the Simpro quote id, and owns the contact name and contact email)
Simpro (issues the quote id and owns the quote value ex GST, the quote stage and the Simpro customer id the quote is raised against)

emits.write: the morning deal-to-quote report where sales administration opens it: the pair contract it ran under, the key it joined on (simpro_quote_id), the owner per field, and the counts matched, within tolerance, mismatched, orphaned and corrected, published every run including the all-clear
emits.readback: the report store returns a report_id, and reading that id back returns the contract id, the five counts and the published time; no id back means the run did not publish and the owner is told

emits.write: an exception on the quote naming the person who owns it: an open difference with the CRM value, the Simpro value and the owning system's value side by side awaiting acceptance, a deal or quote with no partner, a value gap over the threshold, a run over the mismatch rate, or an accepted change whose write returned no id
emits.readback: the exception desk returns an exception_id, and reading that id back returns the simpro quote_id, the field, both values and the exception_owner; no id back means nothing was raised and the run stops
